scope: planar PnP candidates, yaw and translation semantics, camera-gimbal-tracker conversion, single-frame correction attempts, and full observed trajectory behavior
research_state: predictor and multi-hypothesis tracker work remain paused
retention_policy: accepted, rejected, superseded, invalid and failed experiments are retained; a summary or percentile never replaces point-level data and file hashes

current_production_contract.translation_solver: OpenCV solvePnPGeneric SOLVEPNP_IPPE over refined-or-fallback bl/tl/tr/br corners; candidates are sorted by reprojection RMS and candidate 0 is selected
current_production_contract.translation_representation: selected free_ippe_refined camera-frame tvec, converted from millimetres through the calibrated camera-to-gimbal-to-tracker SE(3) chain
current_production_contract.yaw_solver: ordinary-armor tracker/chassis yaw with fixed +15 degree tilt projected through the exposure-matched optical pose

experiment_families.finding: tracked_id and jump_flag changed far faster than a physical quarter-turn and therefore could not be treated as ground-truth armor identity
the ordinary-armor +15 degree tilt belongs to tracker/chassis coordinates and must be projected through the exposure optical pose; synthetic recovery error was below 0.1 degree
joint refined only slightly reduced reprojection residual and did not consistently improve temporal increments; the raw-corner arm lowered residual further but worsened temporal tails

experiment_families.category: downstream current-state reconstruction, not a PnP solver change
experiment_families.status: held-out state A/B failed; later same-session capacity result remained diagnostic, and Module A was superseded by later clean-physics work
experiment_families.boundary: truth-derived labels were training/evaluation only; no future work is resumed by this registry

experiment_families.status: direct substitution and external correction were rejected; dual-domain F was retained as diagnostic only
findings: direct real-PnP substitution raised conditional P95 from 5.63 to 1350.31 mm for translation, 25.40 to 368.06 mm for rotation, and 81.04 to 937.01 mm for combined motion
a true observation mapper reduced combined current P95 from 179.51 to 120.40 mm but frozen-chain conditional P95 remained 536.82 mm
the diagnostic PnP-domain F reached conditional P50/P95/P99 39.70/215.85/537.76 mm but retained oracle association and adaptive-validation limitations

experiment_families.finding: the exact position contract closes numerically; historical large raw-PnP percentiles are reproduced by omitting R_gimbal_pose_to_tracker from the truth label

experiment_families.status: accepted as evidence against identity-plus-small-noise; no correction model selected
experiment_families.finding: leave-one-session-out P50/P95/P99 improved from 304/1780/3069 mm for raw PnP to 146/517/943 mm with corners, both candidates and reprojection features, but tails remained too large and same-session splits were over-optimistic

experiment_families.status: mechanism evidence; no universal replacement selected
findings: exact projected corners reproduce the target pose to numerical precision
actual raw/refined free-IPPE errors are heavy-tailed and controlled 1 px short-edge modes can create large depth errors
known-tilt raw improved 61.7 percent inside its workspace but refined improved only 47.0 percent, so benefits depend on error direction and geometry

experiment_families.category: constant, linear and quadratic correction probes
experiment_families.finding: fixed bias and support-domain linear structure exist, but two-session conditional models failed session transfer and nonlinear models overfit

experiment_families.status: accepted descriptive evidence; no correction selected
experiment_families.finding: position tails grow with range, image-center residual grows with obliquity, and the relationship is not a simple monotonic yaw function; the 6.2 m, 75 degree condition also lost detection coverage
nearby selected-PnP XYZ values can map to materially separated truth positions; the strongest conditioned inverse used oracle phase/slot/rate and is not deployable

findings: identity mapping over 180289 paired rows has overall RMSE/P95 0.3649/0.8306 m; cross-session affine improves to 0.2203/0.4222 m
oracle-conditioned mapping reaches 0.0199/0.0392 m but uses offline truth phase and is not deployable
constant true spin becomes a repeatable phase-nonuniform PnP apparent speed with phase max/min 1.61 to 2.45 and cross-session curve correlation 0.691 to 0.981

experiment_families.category: overall trajectory geometry and IPPE branch hypothesis
experiment_families.status: branch-switch hypothesis rejected for both bounded captures
findings: 31 of 31 selected solver index 0 with zero switches at 2.2 m
767 of 767 selected solver index 0 with zero switches at 5 m
candidate separation was millimetres while selected-pose truth error was centimetres to metres; residual fault is corner/depth conditioning

experiment_families.status: accepted for observation behavior and offline method comparison; not deployment acceptance
findings: spin angular P50/P95 is 0.0705/0.2047 degree but depth P50/P95 is 0.0974/0.8285 m
combined angular P50/P95 is 0.1544/0.3346 degree but depth P50/P95 is 0.1082/0.8630 m
lag-1 angular-error autocorrelation is 0.831 spin and 0.741 combined, with long missing streaks
repeatable observed open arcs do not imply geometrically correct physical arcs

experiment_families.status: offline CV plus u/v Ridge accepted conditionally; predictor and tracker continuation paused
experiment_families.boundary: this is not a PnP correction and does not repair physical identity; hard cyclic association produced catastrophic end-to-end tails

superseded_or_rejected_interpretations: tracked_id or jump_flag is physical armor identity
the old truth camera lateral sign is correct
a global fourth-order polynomial proves a U-shaped or flipped physical trajectory
old angular-only slot assignment establishes four physical plates
IPPE candidate index switching caused the observed arc flip
5 m empty Stage3 rows were primarily PnP rejection
directory radius labels prove that physical radius changed
lower reprojection error alone proves a better pose
selected PnP XYZ equals truth position plus small stationary Gaussian noise
single-frame nonlinear correction validated inside one session generalizes across sessions
